items.name: ui/media-vision/media-dropzone
items.title: Media Dropzone
items.description: A drag-and-drop + click-to-browse image upload zone with idle / drag-over / processing states, accept-list + max-size validation via validateFile, an "add another" variant, and an onFiles(File[]) callback.
items.author: LocalMode

items.name: ui/media-vision/bounding-box-overlay
items.title: Bounding Box Overlay
items.description: Color-coded detection boxes (with a companion DetectionLabelLegend) positioned over an image as percentage offsets from its natural dimensions, so placement is display-size independent. Serves object / face / hand / pose output.
items.author: LocalMode

items.name: ui/media-vision/before-after-image-viewer
items.title: Before / After Image Viewer
items.description: Compare an original image with a transformed result — a two-panel grid with checkerboard transparency (shipped inline) or a segmented Original / Enhanced toggle. Pairs with useImageToImage / useSegmentImage.
items.author: LocalMode

items.name: ui/media-vision/image-processing-overlay
items.title: Image Processing Overlay
items.description: A full-bleed overlay over a dimmed source image while vision inference runs — spinner ring + icon + status + optional cancel, plus an animated scan variant (keyframes shipped inline). Renders nothing when idle. Driven by any vision hook's isLoading.
items.author: LocalMode

items.name: ui/media-vision/video-canvas
items.title: Video Canvas
items.description: A mirrored 16:9 webcam surface — a video element with a pixel-aligned transparent canvas overlay for landmark / skeleton drawing, an FPS badge, and a child slot. A shell for the MediaPipe streaming trackers (useDetectHands / useDetectPose / useDetectFace / useRecognizeGesture); the app supplies the stream and draw callback.
items.author: LocalMode

items.name: ui/media-vision/image-result-gallery
items.title: Image Result Gallery
items.description: A responsive grid / list of image result cards sharing one data contract — in-flight overlay, hover metadata, confidence score, multi-select, delete, and staggered fade-in. Composes ConfidenceScoreBadge (Results family) via a registry dependency, with a minimal score-badge fallback inlined so it builds independently. Pairs with useClassifyImageZeroShot / useEmbedImage / useCaptionImage.
items.author: LocalMode

items.name: ui/media-vision/use-webcam
items.title: useWebcam
items.description: A React hook that owns a getUserMedia video stream: start() acquires (or re-acquires after a denial — the retry path), stop() releases every track, and unmount cleanup guarantees the camera light goes off. Runtime permission denial surfaces as a recoverable error (permission / hardware / unknown) rather than a thrown exception. Returns { stream, isActive, error, start, stop, clearError }; exports WebcamError / WebcamErrorKind. Imports only React and browser APIs — zero @localmode. Powers webcam-driven vision surfaces (object detection, live landmark tracking).
items.author: LocalMode
